title: How to delete a calibration from follower?
body: When I delete a calibration from the calibration data table using master (#624), the deletion works correctly. But when I do the same using follower, the calibration record turns red but the slope and intercept do not become 0 and the calibration is not deleted from calibration graph on master.

comments.body: @Pikernot Is this still the case with recent releases of xDrip?
